messages.name: nx.create_nxopen_script
messages.content:
# =========================================================================
# Siemens NX 12.0 Python Open API Parametric Journal
# Intent: Parametric Generation of Engineered Workpiece
# Material: Cr12MoV | OD: 53.0mm | ID: 14.2mm
# =========================================================================

import NXOpen
import NXOpen.UF
import math

def main():
    the_session = NXOpen.Session.GetSession()
    the_uf_session = NXOpen.UF.UFSession.GetUFSession()
    work_part = the_session.Parts.Work

    # 1. Define Parametric Expressions in Expression Manager
    exp_mgr = work_part.Expressions
    mm = work_part.UnitCollection.FindObject("MilliMeter")
    
    exp_mgr.CreateWithUnits("D_OUTER", f"[{mm.FullName}] 53.0")
    exp_mgr.CreateWithUnits("D_BORE", f"[{mm.FullName}] 14.2")
    exp_mgr.CreateWithUnits("TOTAL_LENGTH", f"[{mm.FullName}] 160.0")
    exp_mgr.CreateWithUnits("GROOVE_R", f"[{mm.FullName}] 1.5")

    # 2. Create Outer Cylinder Stock
    # CreateCyl1(FeatureSign, Origin[3], Height, Diameter, Direction[3])
    cyl_tag = the_uf_session.Modl.CreateCyl1(
        NXOpen.UF.UFModl.FeatureSigns.Nullsign,
        [0.0, 0.0, 0.0],
        f"160.0",
        f"53.0",
        [0.0, 0.0, -1.0]
    )

    # 3. Create Inner Bore Cylinder (Boolean Subtraction)
    bore_tag = the_uf_session.Modl.CreateCyl1(
        NXOpen.UF.UFModl.FeatureSigns.Negative,
        [0.0, 0.0, 0.0],
        f"165.0",
        f"14.2",
        [0.0, 0.0, -1.0]
    )

    # 4. Create Multi-Step Radial Grooves (Torus Boolean Subtractions)
    pitch = 26.67
    for i in range(1, 6):
        z_pos = -pitch * i
        # CreateTorus(FeatureSign, Center[3], RingDia, TubeDia, Direction[3])
        the_uf_session.Modl.CreateTorus(
            NXOpen.UF.UFModl.FeatureSigns.Negative,
            [0.0, 0.0, z_pos],
            f"50.0",
            f"3.0",
            [0.0, 0.0, 1.0]
        )

    # 5. Update and Save Work Part
    the_uf_session.Modl.Update()
    print("[SUCCESS] Siemens NX 12.0 Parametric Model & Features Built.")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

messages.name: nx.create_nxopen_script
messages.content:
# =========================================================================
# Siemens NX 12.0 Python Open API Parametric Journal
# Intent: Parametric Generation of Engineered Workpiece
# Material: Ti-6Al-4V | OD: 48.0mm | ID: 14.4mm
# =========================================================================

import NXOpen
import NXOpen.UF
import math

def main():
    the_session = NXOpen.Session.GetSession()
    the_uf_session = NXOpen.UF.UFSession.GetUFSession()
    work_part = the_session.Parts.Work

    # 1. Define Parametric Expressions in Expression Manager
    exp_mgr = work_part.Expressions
    mm = work_part.UnitCollection.FindObject("MilliMeter")
    
    exp_mgr.CreateWithUnits("D_OUTER", f"[{mm.FullName}] 48.0")
    exp_mgr.CreateWithUnits("D_BORE", f"[{mm.FullName}] 14.4")
    exp_mgr.CreateWithUnits("TOTAL_LENGTH", f"[{mm.FullName}] 160.0")
    exp_mgr.CreateWithUnits("GROOVE_R", f"[{mm.FullName}] 1.5")

    # 2. Create Outer Cylinder Stock
    # CreateCyl1(FeatureSign, Origin[3], Height, Diameter, Direction[3])
    cyl_tag = the_uf_session.Modl.CreateCyl1(
        NXOpen.UF.UFModl.FeatureSigns.Nullsign,
        [0.0, 0.0, 0.0],
        f"160.0",
        f"48.0",
        [0.0, 0.0, -1.0]
    )

    # 3. Create Inner Bore Cylinder (Boolean Subtraction)
    bore_tag = the_uf_session.Modl.CreateCyl1(
        NXOpen.UF.UFModl.FeatureSigns.Negative,
        [0.0, 0.0, 0.0],
        f"165.0",
        f"14.4",
        [0.0, 0.0, -1.0]
    )

    # 4. Create Multi-Step Radial Grooves (Torus Boolean Subtractions)
    pitch = 53.33
    for i in range(1, 3):
        z_pos = -pitch * i
        # CreateTorus(FeatureSign, Center[3], RingDia, TubeDia, Direction[3])
        the_uf_session.Modl.CreateTorus(
            NXOpen.UF.UFModl.FeatureSigns.Negative,
            [0.0, 0.0, z_pos],
            f"45.0",
            f"3.0",
            [0.0, 0.0, 1.0]
        )

    # 5. Update and Save Work Part
    the_uf_session.Modl.Update()
    print("[SUCCESS] Siemens NX 12.0 Parametric Model & Features Built.")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

messages.name: nx.create_nxopen_script
messages.content:
# =========================================================================
# Siemens NX 12.0 Python Open API Parametric Journal
# Intent: Parametric Generation of Engineered Workpiece
# Material: Ti-6Al-4V | OD: 53.0mm | ID: 15.9mm
# =========================================================================

import NXOpen
import NXOpen.UF
import math

def main():
    the_session = NXOpen.Session.GetSession()
    the_uf_session = NXOpen.UF.UFSession.GetUFSession()
    work_part = the_session.Parts.Work

    # 1. Define Parametric Expressions in Expression Manager
    exp_mgr = work_part.Expressions
    mm = work_part.UnitCollection.FindObject("MilliMeter")
    
    exp_mgr.CreateWithUnits("D_OUTER", f"[{mm.FullName}] 53.0")
    exp_mgr.CreateWithUnits("D_BORE", f"[{mm.FullName}] 15.9")
    exp_mgr.CreateWithUnits("TOTAL_LENGTH", f"[{mm.FullName}] 40.0")
    exp_mgr.CreateWithUnits("GROOVE_R", f"[{mm.FullName}] 3.0")

    # 2. Create Outer Cylinder Stock
    # CreateCyl1(FeatureSign, Origin[3], Height, Diameter, Direction[3])
    cyl_tag = the_uf_session.Modl.CreateCyl1(
        NXOpen.UF.UFModl.FeatureSigns.Nullsign,
        [0.0, 0.0, 0.0],
        f"40.0",
        f"53.0",
        [0.0, 0.0, -1.0]
    )

    # 3. Create Inner Bore Cylinder (Boolean Subtraction)
    bore_tag = the_uf_session.Modl.CreateCyl1(
        NXOpen.UF.UFModl.FeatureSigns.Negative,
        [0.0, 0.0, 0.0],
        f"45.0",
        f"15.9",
        [0.0, 0.0, -1.0]
    )

    # 4. Create Multi-Step Radial Grooves (Torus Boolean Subtractions)
    pitch = 8.00
    for i in range(1, 5):
        z_pos = -pitch * i
        # CreateTorus(FeatureSign, Center[3], RingDia, TubeDia, Direction[3])
        the_uf_session.Modl.CreateTorus(
            NXOpen.UF.UFModl.FeatureSigns.Negative,
            [0.0, 0.0, z_pos],
            f"47.0",
            f"6.0",
            [0.0, 0.0, 1.0]
        )

    # 5. Update and Save Work Part
    the_uf_session.Modl.Update()
    print("[SUCCESS] Siemens NX 12.0 Parametric Model & Features Built.")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

messages.name: nx.create_nxopen_script
messages.content:
# =========================================================================
# Siemens NX 12.0 Python Open API Parametric Journal
# Intent: Parametric Generation of Engineered Workpiece
# Material: Ti-6Al-4V | OD: 48.0mm | ID: 14.4mm
# =========================================================================

import NXOpen
import NXOpen.UF
import math

def main():
    the_session = NXOpen.Session.GetSession()
    the_uf_session = NXOpen.UF.UFSession.GetUFSession()
    work_part = the_session.Parts.Work

    # 1. Define Parametric Expressions in Expression Manager
    exp_mgr = work_part.Expressions
    mm = work_part.UnitCollection.FindObject("MilliMeter")
    
    exp_mgr.CreateWithUnits("D_OUTER", f"[{mm.FullName}] 48.0")
    exp_mgr.CreateWithUnits("D_BORE", f"[{mm.FullName}] 14.4")
    exp_mgr.CreateWithUnits("TOTAL_LENGTH", f"[{mm.FullName}] 160.0")
    exp_mgr.CreateWithUnits("GROOVE_R", f"[{mm.FullName}] 2.0")

    # 2. Create Outer Cylinder Stock
    # CreateCyl1(FeatureSign, Origin[3], Height, Diameter, Direction[3])
    cyl_tag = the_uf_session.Modl.CreateCyl1(
        NXOpen.UF.UFModl.FeatureSigns.Nullsign,
        [0.0, 0.0, 0.0],
        f"160.0",
        f"48.0",
        [0.0, 0.0, -1.0]
    )

    # 3. Create Inner Bore Cylinder (Boolean Subtraction)
    bore_tag = the_uf_session.Modl.CreateCyl1(
        NXOpen.UF.UFModl.FeatureSigns.Negative,
        [0.0, 0.0, 0.0],
        f"165.0",
        f"14.4",
        [0.0, 0.0, -1.0]
    )

    # 4. Create Multi-Step Radial Grooves (Torus Boolean Subtractions)
    pitch = 17.78
    for i in range(1, 9):
        z_pos = -pitch * i
        # CreateTorus(FeatureSign, Center[3], RingDia, TubeDia, Direction[3])
        the_uf_session.Modl.CreateTorus(
            NXOpen.UF.UFModl.FeatureSigns.Negative,
            [0.0, 0.0, z_pos],
            f"44.0",
            f"4.0",
            [0.0, 0.0, 1.0]
        )

    # 5. Update and Save Work Part
    the_uf_session.Modl.Update()
    print("[SUCCESS] Siemens NX 12.0 Parametric Model & Features Built.")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

skip.description: 跳过阶段列表，可选 sw2021, nx12, acad2026, cimco2026, vericut96, sscnc72

# =========================================================================
# Siemens NX 12.0 Python Open API Parametric Journal
# Intent: Parametric Generation of Engineered Workpiece
# Material: Ti-6Al-4V | OD: 53.0mm | ID: 15.9mm
# =========================================================================

import NXOpen
import NXOpen.UF
import math

def main():
    the_session = NXOpen.Session.GetSession()
    the_uf_session = NXOpen.UF.UFSession.GetUFSession()
    work_part = the_session.Parts.Work

    # 1. Define Parametric Expressions in Expression Manager
    exp_mgr = work_part.Expressions
    mm = work_part.UnitCollection.FindObject("MilliMeter")
    
    exp_mgr.CreateWithUnits("D_OUTER", f"[{mm.FullName}] 53.0")
    exp_mgr.CreateWithUnits("D_BORE", f"[{mm.FullName}] 15.9")
    exp_mgr.CreateWithUnits("TOTAL_LENGTH", f"[{mm.FullName}] 60.0")
    exp_mgr.CreateWithUnits("GROOVE_R", f"[{mm.FullName}] 8.0")

    # 2. Create Outer Cylinder Stock
    # CreateCyl1(FeatureSign, Origin[3], Height, Diameter, Direction[3])
    cyl_tag = the_uf_session.Modl.CreateCyl1(
        NXOpen.UF.UFModl.FeatureSigns.Nullsign,
        [0.0, 0.0, 0.0],
        f"60.0",
        f"53.0",
        [0.0, 0.0, -1.0]
    )

    # 3. Create Inner Bore Cylinder (Boolean Subtraction)
    bore_tag = the_uf_session.Modl.CreateCyl1(
        NXOpen.UF.UFModl.FeatureSigns.Negative,
        [0.0, 0.0, 0.0],
        f"65.0",
        f"15.9",
        [0.0, 0.0, -1.0]
    )

    # 4. Create Multi-Step Radial Grooves (Torus Boolean Subtractions)
    pitch = 12.00
    for i in range(1, 5):
        z_pos = -pitch * i
        # CreateTorus(FeatureSign, Center[3], RingDia, TubeDia, Direction[3])
        the_uf_session.Modl.CreateTorus(
            NXOpen.UF.UFModl.FeatureSigns.Negative,
            [0.0, 0.0, z_pos],
            f"37.0",
            f"16.0",
            [0.0, 0.0, 1.0]
        )

    # 5. Update and Save Work Part
    the_uf_session.Modl.Update()
    print("[SUCCESS] Siemens NX 12.0 Parametric Model & Features Built.")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

messages.name: nx.create_nxopen_script
messages.content:
# =========================================================================
# Siemens NX 12.0 Python Open API Parametric Journal
# Intent: Parametric Generation of Engineered Workpiece
# Material: Ti-6Al-4V | OD: 53.0mm | ID: 15.9mm
# =========================================================================

import NXOpen
import NXOpen.UF
import math

def main():
    the_session = NXOpen.Session.GetSession()
    the_uf_session = NXOpen.UF.UFSession.GetUFSession()
    work_part = the_session.Parts.Work

    # 1. Define Parametric Expressions in Expression Manager
    exp_mgr = work_part.Expressions
    mm = work_part.UnitCollection.FindObject("MilliMeter")
    
    exp_mgr.CreateWithUnits("D_OUTER", f"[{mm.FullName}] 53.0")
    exp_mgr.CreateWithUnits("D_BORE", f"[{mm.FullName}] 15.9")
    exp_mgr.CreateWithUnits("TOTAL_LENGTH", f"[{mm.FullName}] 30.0")
    exp_mgr.CreateWithUnits("GROOVE_R", f"[{mm.FullName}] 5.0")

    # 2. Create Outer Cylinder Stock
    # CreateCyl1(FeatureSign, Origin[3], Height, Diameter, Direction[3])
    cyl_tag = the_uf_session.Modl.CreateCyl1(
        NXOpen.UF.UFModl.FeatureSigns.Nullsign,
        [0.0, 0.0, 0.0],
        f"30.0",
        f"53.0",
        [0.0, 0.0, -1.0]
    )

    # 3. Create Inner Bore Cylinder (Boolean Subtraction)
    bore_tag = the_uf_session.Modl.CreateCyl1(
        NXOpen.UF.UFModl.FeatureSigns.Negative,
        [0.0, 0.0, 0.0],
        f"35.0",
        f"15.9",
        [0.0, 0.0, -1.0]
    )

    # 4. Create Multi-Step Radial Grooves (Torus Boolean Subtractions)
    pitch = 7.50
    for i in range(1, 4):
        z_pos = -pitch * i
        # CreateTorus(FeatureSign, Center[3], RingDia, TubeDia, Direction[3])
        the_uf_session.Modl.CreateTorus(
            NXOpen.UF.UFModl.FeatureSigns.Negative,
            [0.0, 0.0, z_pos],
            f"43.0",
            f"10.0",
            [0.0, 0.0, 1.0]
        )

    # 5. Update and Save Work Part
    the_uf_session.Modl.Update()
    print("[SUCCESS] Siemens NX 12.0 Parametric Model & Features Built.")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
